name: com.kenxcomp/kenotex-mcp
description: Let your coding agent manage real todos, calendar events, and check-in habits in Kenotex, a native macOS/iOS planner. Local SQLite, no cloud round-trip.

environmentVariables.name: KENOTEX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Override the auto-discovered local API token. Normally unnecessary — the server finds it on disk.

environmentVariables.name: KENOTEX_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Override the local server address. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:21519.
